sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission investigated the involvement of the Housing Authority in the Stella Orion housing development.
sentences.support: The Commission commenced Operation Skerryvore to enquire into the project.

sentences.text: The Commission estimated a loss of $29,049,936 to the Department of Communities, which questioned the amount without providing an alternative.
sentences.support: The Commission estimates the current loss to DoC at $29,049,936.

sentences.text: The Commission formed no opinion of serious misconduct and was satisfied that those involved acted in good faith rather than corruptly.
sentences.support: After extensive investigation the Commission has formed no opinion of serious misconduct.

sentences.text: The Commission identified risks involving inadequate due diligence, inaccessible records and insufficient supervision of a consultant making financial decisions.
sentences.support: A person engaged as a consultant made extensive managerial and commercial decisions without adequate supervision by the Director General.

notes: INTRODUCTION provides the investigation outcome and a consolidated account of misconduct risks. The existing OPAX finding is not duplicated.
